subject: Globex: Technical evidence pack for private deployment (VPC/on-prem)
messages:
From: Jake Turner <jturner@globex.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request for technical evidence: VPC / on-prem private deployment

Soojin,

Thanks for the call earlier — Globex security team is compiling evidence for our procurement so we can sign off on the Private deployment clause. Can you provide a consolidated evidence pack that covers the following items? We need the pack by COB Apr 20 to make the architecture review meeting on Apr 22.

Requested items (brief):
- Network architecture diagram showing VPC peering & private link flows
- KMS/HSM integration notes and sample key rotation policy
- Air-gapped deployment options & required offline steps
- Audit/logging sources, retention policies, and sample log lines (audit IDs sanitized)
- SOC2/ISO artifact references or where to request them

If you can include a point of contact for follow-ups and an encrypted archive for any sensitive docs, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Jake
Jake Turner
Director, Infrastructure Security
Globex Financial Services
[jturner@globex.com]

[Attachment: globex-evidence-request.pdf (pdf)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jake Turner <jturner@globex.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-16T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for technical evidence: VPC / on-prem private deployment

Jake —

Appreciate the clear list. Attached is an initial evidence packet that addresses each bullet. Summary of contents:

- redwood-vpc-evidence.pdf: single-page network diagram + narrative describing supported topologies (VPC peering, AWS PrivateLink, Azure Private Endpoint, GCP VPC-SC) and recommended routing patterns for egress control.
- network-arch-diagram.png: high-res diagram used by our solutions engineering team.
- redwood-kms-integration-summary.docx: covers KMS/HSM integrations (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS) and an example key rotation schedule (30/90/365 day templates).

Quick clarifications (so you have context):
- Private deployment modes: we support (1) Dedicated VPC with PrivateLink to our control plane, (2) Fully private control plane deployed into customer VPC via our Private Appliance, and (3) On-prem air-gapped bundle for regulated environments. Each option has different operational trade-offs; the packet includes a short table.
- Audit logs: we ship structured audit events (JSON) to either customer-managed S3/GCS/Azure Blob or push to a syslog/Siem endpoint. Retention is configurable; we provide an example 13-month retention policy for enterprise customers.

We attached an encrypted archive with additional compliance artifacts (SOC2 cert pointer, signed data processing addendum) — password will be shared via separate channel (per your request). If you want, I can schedule a 30m walkthrough Thursday (Apr 22) after your architecture review.

Kind regards,

Soojin Lee
Head of Solutions — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0178

[Attachments: redwood-vpc-evidence.pdf (pdf), network-arch-diagram.png (png), redwood-kms-integration-summary.docx (docx), redwood-evidence-enc.zip (zip)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-04-18T08:39:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Globex follow-up - clarify air-gapped ops steps

Soojin / Laura —

FW: Globex request. A couple quick operational notes to include if we get asked during the review:

- Air-gapped install checklist (high level):
  * Preflight: hardware inventory, OS baseline (we support RHEL8, Ubuntu 20+), network isolation verification.
  * Transfer media: signed installer + SHA256 checksums on USB keys; verification instructions in the installer README.
  * Secrets: onboarding uses ephemeral bootstrap tokens and requires manual KMS import for HSM-backed keys.
  * Updates: offline patch bundle process (we provide delta bundles and verification steps).

- SLA-wise: Private Appliance has a defined maintenance window; for air-gapped customers we recommend monthly patch cadence with staged rollouts.
- Suggest we add the air-gap checklist page from our internal runbook into the evidence pack (sanitized).

I'll leave the final wording to Soojin — adding it will preempt questions about offline patching and verification.

— Vivek
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
